title: Do not mistake one page for a complete export
prompt:
An API page returns IDs A01 and A02 and next_cursor=p2. The next_cursor value is nonempty until all pages are consumed. The task is a complete export.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. complete: boolean; next_action: fetch_next_page or publish_export; cursor: string or null.
remediation_hints: Follow pagination to exhaustion before declaring an export complete.
